correctness.rationale: The only maximal proper unital F_q-subalgebras are the q+1 rational line stabilizers and the q(q−1)/2 conjugate quadratic fields. Indeed an irreducibly acting subalgebra acts faithfully on a simple module, so is simple, and the dimension-two module permits only the quadratic field or the full algebra. Quadratic fields are conjugate by identification of the natural space as the one-dimensional module over the field and their normalizer has size 2(q²−1). Distinct line stabilizers meet in a split diagonal algebra, at least three meet in scalars, and every field intersection with a different maximal subalgebra is also scalars. On full matrices, a line stabilizer, a split diagonal algebra, and a quadratic field the trace is surjective (on the field it is the separable field trace). Their prescribed-fiber sizes are q^(3m), q^(2m), q^m, q^m. Put b=q+1, e=q(q−1)/2 and let s count scalar tuples in the fiber: all scalar terms cancel with coefficient 1−b+binom(b,2)−e=0, regardless of s in characteristic two. This gives q^m(q^m−1)(q^m−q), zero exactly at m=1 in the stated domain. For the product, each surjective evaluation of the free unital algebra has a maximal two-sided kernel. Two evaluations have equal kernel precisely when an automorphism relates their tuples; distinct kernels are pairwise comaximal, so the Chinese remainder theorem gives surjectivity, while equal kernels force a graph relation. Distinct kernels, not abstract nonisomorphism of their quotient algebras, are the criterion in the proof. The PGL action is free, giving the stated falling-factor product and at m=2 the orbit count q^4(q−1). Independent exact checks at branches/a2e0ba22-fe4c-466a-9e5f-0c0f48d6d42e/ord1_independent_reproduction.py with repro_q2.txt and repro_q3.txt reproduced q=2,3 pair fibers (24 and 432 per trace) and 8640 generating pairs for q=2,k=2; these are bounded checks, not the universal proof.

Intersect the displayed pieces with the prescribed trace fiber before taking cardinalities. In the old display replace ambient q^(4m) by q^(3m), Borel q^(3m) by q^(2m), the field and split diagonal q^(2m) by q^m, and the subtracted scalar count q^m by s. originality.rationale: The trace-fiber law is not read off the unconditioned cardinality alone in characteristic two. The stronger decisive evidence is the explicit signed maximal-subalgebra set count in Kravchenko–Mazur–Petrenko (2012), §7A, which already supplies every contributing subset, its coefficient and the cancellation of the scalar contribution. Restrict that calculation to a trace fiber and use the elementary surjectivity of trace on each remaining subspace; this mechanically yields the entire result, even in characteristic two. Their Theorem 6.3 and equation (9) also already give the complete direct-power census and cutoff. This is verified implication, not a claim that the precise trace-conditioned formula is explicitly printed. No independently non-implied remainder survives.
residual_risks: An explicit earlier formulation of the characteristic-two trace law may exist; the decision does not rely on finding one.
The same-day restricted-idempotent record's date does not establish priority or coverage. Its actual domain is narrower.

value.rationale: Equidistribution under a prescribed trace is a natural statistic, but here it reduces exactly to slicing the complete previously known signed count by a surjective linear map on every surviving piece. The even-characteristic nuance is a useful clarification of that argument, not an additional difficult-to-obtain invariant under the implication standard. The other displayed results are already exact prior formulas, leaving no distinct worthwhile claim to retain by narrowing.
